video_title: Vince Carter & T-Mac On Why the Rockets Are a Threat in the West & Disappointing NBA Teams

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's impact on the Houston Rockets' team performance
quotes.excerpt: Fred coming back was it and it just unlocks everything. Guys take the pressure off of them.
quotes.quote: I'm going to stick with the team I said earlier. The Houston Rockets are going to be the team that's going to wake people up. From the beginning, I felt Fred coming back was it and it just unlocks everything. Guys take the pressure off of them. You see Reed Sheppard grow the fro in the nasty mustache and come out here balling. He is balling.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The Western Conference is weaker this year, favoring the Rockets
quotes.excerpt: This year is like the perfect year for them in terms of the West isn't as strong.
quotes.quote: This year is like the perfect year for them in terms of the West isn't as strong as it was before. Last year, I'm saying exactly, I'm saying the West isn't as strong as it was if we looked at it from the beginning of the season. To me, it was only Minnesota, OKC, San Antonio, and Houston. Everybody else after that, Denver is not strong. I don't think Denver is strong defensively. They don't have no rim protector. They can't guard.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The Houston Rockets are a top team in the West
quotes.excerpt: I think they are the top team in the Western Conference and they should make it.
quotes.quote: I think they are the top team in the Western Conference and they should make it to the Western Conference finals based off of how it's lined up right now with injuries and how they are playing they're fully healthy. And you know a fully healthy team throughout the season, New York showed that they were one of the more healthier teams, OKC showed that they were one of the more healthier teams, San Antonio showed that they were one of the more healthier teams.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's veteran presence as a point guard for Houston
quotes.excerpt: You need a point guard that can be a facilitator to take the pressure off him.
quotes.quote: We've always talked about with Houston or with Kevin Durant in general, you need a point guard that can be a facilitator to take the pressure off him so he can be him. Fred VanVleet is that. He's not a young guy, he's a veteran, he's a champion, he's been around, he understands how to play the position. And he's also a guy if you dare double team him, you can't leave him open. They do have someone else that Amen Thompson is probably the guy I would choose to leave open.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's return to form and his bully ball style
quotes.excerpt: He is on a mission. He is bringing bully ball back.
quotes.quote: He is on a mission. He is bringing bully ball back. He is bringing bully ball back. So you better have a center that can withstand bully ball. I was so disappointed in Vucevic the other night when he was guarding him. You cannot let him get the leverage on you on the baseline. Cut the baseline off, make him go to the middle. Why are you letting him get up under you on the baseline, use his strength and just go up?

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The Toronto Raptors' performance despite Kawhi Leonard's absence
quotes.excerpt: Look out for the Raptors and this is obviously with Kawhi Leonard who is out.
quotes.quote: I said the Raptors, look out for the Raptors and this is obviously with Kawhi Leonard who is out and they're still playing great basketball. I think right now they're third in the East behind Philly and Pistons. I felt like they were a team that with all of the hype of talking about Pistons, Celtics, 76ers, maybe Cavs, we would forget about what Toronto already had and what they gained.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Toronto's defensive identity and the need for a scorer
quotes.excerpt: They were a great defensive team, they always in games, and fourth quarter games they just couldn't.
quotes.quote: I thought Toronto was one of those teams that were like Houston a few years ago before Kawhi came there. They were a great defensive team, they always in games, and fourth quarter games they just couldn't close out games because they didn't have that one guy. But their defense kept them in games. I just felt like they needed that one scorer and that's why I was screaming at that time, man, if they had Cam Thomas, somebody that could take and make bad shot, tough shots, it probably be a different story for them.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The Miami Heat's disappointing roster construction and trade needs
quotes.excerpt: I never really put too much stock into Miami when they made the trade anyway.
quotes.quote: I think Miami is that team is like everybody is in uproar, but I never really put too much stock into Miami when they made the trade anyway because I felt like they didn't have enough still. They are missing some pieces. I felt like they needed to do more. Although they were adding Kyle Lowry and Tim Hardaway to the mix. I'm not going to overreact because Pat Riley, Erik Spoelstra like these guys are basketball savants. They see what we see. So I'm sure they're going to make some some trades and improve.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: The Denver Nuggets' lack of depth and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I'm just not feeling like they have that same mojo is gone.
quotes.quote: It has to be the Nuggets. I'm just not feeling like they have that same mojo is gone. I don't feel the same way about that team and their contention. I don't feel like they're a contender. I think there's a lot of holes that needs to be filled. I'm not really sure how they're utilizing DeMar DeRozan personnel seems like it doesn't match. There's a lot of questions about this team. Jokic is going to be Jokic, he's going to put up his triple doubles, but to me it's like you don't want to lose that with him.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: The San Antonio Spurs' lack of dominance in the West
quotes.excerpt: I just don't have the feeling at the moment like they're the dominant team in the West.
quotes.quote: For me, I'm going to say San Antonio. Not because they're not good, I'm not saying that Spurs fans, any of that. I just don't have the feeling at the moment like they're the dominant team in the West. We talked a lot about Wembanyama going to win all the awards. We talk about how good Dylan Windler is, their squad is, how well they played. I don't know if it's a hangover from just having the success because at the same time, as much as the Knicks are going to be the hunted, I still think the San Antonio Spurs are the hunted.
